summary: amazon.aws autoscaling_group deprecates decrement_desired_capacity, detach_instances and replace_instances (use autoscaling_instance) and replace_batch_size, lc_check, lt_check and replace_all_instances (use autoscaling_instance_refresh), all for removal in 14.0.0.
questions: How should I do a rolling replacement of ASG instances now?

answer_card.title: autoscaling_group instance management deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
In `amazon.aws.autoscaling_group` (removal in 14.0.0):
- `decrement_desired_capacity`, `detach_instances`, `replace_instances`: use `amazon.aws.autoscaling_instance`.
- `replace_all_instances`, `replace_batch_size`, `lc_check`, `lt_check`: use `amazon.aws.autoscaling_instance_refresh` for rolling replacement.
